name: open-metadata-preserved
description: metadata is open by key: vendor-prefixed keys the protocol has never heard of survive untouched and draw no warning, and a null under a key is data rather than an absence
kill: give MetadataSchema a described shape (say z.looseObject({}) with named keys, or a recursive JSON-value schema walked by stripAgainst) instead of the opaque z.custom — every vendor key is then stripped with a warning and never reaches the message

dotnet.intentional: Message metadata is a wire-level field in .NET: TEXT_MESSAGE_START and TEXT_MESSAGE_END update builder state and yield no ChatResponseUpdate, so anything carried only on them never reaches a consumer. Deliberate and documented in docs/concepts/metadata.mdx; the content still rides along.
